# docx Gotchas

> Known Word OOXML / docx generation patterns that cause silent failures or hard-to-debug errors.

## Entries

- [Bold is a toggle: a bold run inside a bold style renders regular](bold-is-a-toggle-a-bold-run-inside-a-bold-style-renders-regular.md): w:b from styles toggles, so a bold character style inside a bold paragraph style renders NOT bold -- valid XML, every layer says bold, tests pass -- and with a bold-only display font (Poppins) Word silently substitutes another font. Set bold in exactly one style layer or put direct w:b on the run (direct formatting is not toggled), and verify by rendering in Word. HIGH.
- [A table cell's left border widens the table by half its width](a-table-cells-left-border-widens-the-table-by-half-its-width.md): A table exactly as wide as the text column with a thick left rule on a cell (a callout) overhangs the right margin by half the rule width (4.5 pt rule = 45 twips); subtract half the rule from tblW/gridCol/tcW (or compensate with tblInd). Also, a row takes the largest top cell margin of any cell in it, so keep top margins uniform per row. MEDIUM.
